video_title: Wemby was a TOTALLY DIFFERENT PLAYER 😤 Windy's Spurs-Knicks Game 3 takeaways | The Pat McAfee Show

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Victor Wembanyama's energy shift in Game 3
quotes.excerpt: Wembanyama needs to be deeply invested. At this point in his career, maybe when he gets older he'll change.
quotes.quote: Wembanyama needs to be deeply invested. At this point in his career, maybe when he gets older he'll change. Games one and two, I felt like he didn't have good energy. Last night, he had three dunks in the first five minutes. Totally different player.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Spurs' defensive strategy against Jalen Brunson
quotes.excerpt: They've been double-teaming Brunson a lot because they saw how Brunson destroyed the Cleveland Cavaliers.
quotes.quote: They've been double-teaming Brunson a lot because they saw how Brunson destroyed the Cleveland Cavaliers. They double-teamed him a lot and that enabled Brunson to pass out and the Knicks' three-point shooters were crushing the Spurs' defensive strategy.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The mental impact of playing the Spurs
quotes.excerpt: I would love to see a group text between Anthony Edwards, SGA, and now Brunson about playing the Spurs.
quotes.quote: I would love to see a group text between Anthony Edwards, SGA, and now Brunson about what it's like to play the Spurs, because they mess with your head.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Brunson's struggles in the series
quotes.excerpt: He is shooting 36-37 percent. He has as many turnovers as he has assists. This is not who Jalen Brunson is.
quotes.quote: He is shooting 36-37 percent. He has as many turnovers as he has assists. This is not who Jalen Brunson is.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: The 2025 NBA Draft class and Stephon Castle
quotes.excerpt: Zaccharie Risacher number one to the Hawks. Alex Sarr to Wizards. Reed Sheppard to the Rockets. Ime Udoka, his son could be Stephon Castle.
quotes.quote: Zaccharie Risacher number one to the Hawks. Alex Sarr to Wizards. Reed Sheppard to the Rockets. Ime Udoka, his son could be Stephon Castle. But they went with Sheppard for the offense. They crushed that draft.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: They were like, we got him. We got Victor's running mate. We hit the jackpot.
quotes.quote: Two weeks into them having him, they were like, we got him. We got Victor's running mate. We hit the jackpot. The Spurs aren't arrogant. They're like, we got Victor's running mate. We hit the jackpot.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: De'Aaron Fox, who's been around a while, is a star in the league.
quotes.quote: De'Aaron Fox, who's been around a while, is a star in the league. He hits one of the biggest shots of the night to make it a five-point game with 12 seconds left.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: Last year when the finals were over, it turned out Jalen Williams from the Thunder had gotten 35 injections.
quotes.quote: Last year when the finals were over, it turned out Jalen Williams from the Thunder had gotten 35 injections. I don't know if De'Aaron Fox is ever going to tell us, but he's doing some stuff to get himself to play because that ankle isn't right.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.excerpt: They're in a bit of a negotiation right now. They may not be exchanging figures, but they're sort of exchanging postures.
quotes.quote: They're in a bit of a negotiation right now. They may not be exchanging figures, but they're sort of exchanging postures.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Lakers' financial constraints with LeBron James
quotes.excerpt: Every dollar they give to LeBron, they can't give to a free agent because they got to improve this team.
quotes.quote: Every dollar they give to LeBron, they can't give to a free agent because they got to improve this team. It's not like with Kobe, it wasn't about cap space. They gave Kobe a big contract when he was already done. They did it out of honor and respect. The situation is different. Every dollar they give LeBron, they can't give to a free agent. But there has to be a number in there that respects LeBron and that gives the Lakers a chance to still improve their roster. Until I hear from Rich Paul that LeBron is ready to play for 3 million, I'm not going to believe it.
